narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>One tenth and four hundredths make five hundredths, so one and five hundredths.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But a tenth is much bigger than a hundredth, so they cannot be added as they are.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Change the tenth into hundredths first, and then add.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>A length can be written with units, tenths and hundredths, or in hundredths alone.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Your turn. A wire ends three parts after the mark two and four tenths. Write it three ways.
